title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of How to Apply Law to the Act of Stealing Oil Products from an Oil Field Oil Pipeline in Use by Destructive Means

articles.content_en:
Fa Shi [2002] No. 10
Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:
Recently, some Higher People's Courts have requested instructions from this Court on how to apply the law to the act of stealing oil products from an oil pipeline in use by destructive means. In accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law, the reply is as follows:
The oil pipeline in use falls under the "flammable and explosive equipment" as defined in the Criminal Law. Where a person steals oil products from an oil pipeline in use by destructive means, and the act constitutes the crime of destroying flammable and explosive equipment, theft, or other crimes, the person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions for the heavier punishment.
April 10, 2002
